verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's agent Ari could plausibly act as an MCP client, so this axis applies. However, the evidence only documents cfo.ai as an MCP server that outside clients such as Claude Code and Codex connect to. That server role does not count toward plugging MCP servers into the product. Its integrations (QuickBooks, Postgres, Snowflake and others) are native connectors, not user-added MCP servers, and nothing shows users can register external MCP servers for Ari to use.
